name: viaSocket utilities
description: Utility services for viasocket.com provide essential tools and functionalities to enhance and streamline workflow automation, enabling users to connect various applications and automate tasks efficiently.

events.d: Run another workflow from your current workflow. API inputData (Apps API key Flow_in_Flow, auth NoAuth): - flowid (required): child flow script id in the same project. - methodOfPayload (required): "keyvalue" or "bulk"…
Send a prompt and options to an AI model and receive text or JSON responses, images, model details, and usage cost.
Invoke a specific action version using action_version_id and auth_id, sending parsed or raw JSON inputData.
Queue a message for the AI model at lower cost; the step resumes with the reply (content, model, credits) when ready.
